items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private customer data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization (B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical RCE Flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: A critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Patches were released on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49 - Stored Cross-site Scripting
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.7 that could enable arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49 - Path Traversal
items.summary: A critical path traversal vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.7 allowing arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49 - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: Two critical incorrect authorization vulnerabilities (CVSS 7.5 each) leading to security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49 - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
items.summary: A critical Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability (CVSS 7.4) enabling security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49 - Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
items.summary: Multiple critical uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerabilities (CVSS 7.5 each) that could cause application denial-of-service.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. A fix was released in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026.
